• String Comparison: - Compares characters sequentially by Unicode value (e.g., "Mary" > "Mark" because 'y' > 'k').
• Empty Input Testing: - String.Empty or "" represents zero length. - Use .Trim() = String.Empty to detect blank whitespace entries.
• Numeric Validation: - IsNumeric() returns True if a string can safely convert to a number.
• Case Transformation: - ToUpper() / .ToLower() produces a modified copy; original variable data stays untouched.
• Trimming Whitespace: - Trim() removes both leading and trailing spaces. - TrimStart() / .TrimEnd() targets only outer edges.
